# Design 4.2 rows 22 and 23: a `crate.from_specs` hub, which has no
# `Cargo.lock`, and a `crates_vendor` target, which is a BUILD rule and so
# exists under both dependency systems (probe R6).

=== .bazelversion
9.3.2
=== MODULE.bazel
module(name = "app")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_rust", version = "0.75.0")

crate = use_extension("@rules_rust//crate_universe:extensions.bzl", "crate")
crate.from_cargo(
    name = "crates",
    cargo_lockfile = "//:Cargo.lock",
    manifests = ["//:Cargo.toml"],
)
crate.from_specs(name = "specs")
use_repo(crate, "crates", "specs")
=== third_party/BUILD.bazel
load("@rules_rust//crate_universe:defs.bzl", "crates_vendor")

crates_vendor(
    name = "crates_vendor",
    cargo_lockfile = "//:Cargo.lock",
    manifests = ["//:Cargo.toml"],
    mode = "local",
    vendor_path = "crates",
)
=== Cargo.toml
[package]
name = "app"
version = "0.0.0"
=== Cargo.lock
version = 3
